start: Week 1 = first week after the board decision

gates.name: Build ready
criteria: Integration design signed by IT and the TMS vendor
KPI dashboard live with the pre-AI baseline

gates.name: First go-live
criteria: Shadow mode on real documents: straight-through rate at least 60%
Error escape rate at most 1% on the audited sample
Clerks trained; review queue in daily use

gates.name: UC-01 complete, wave 2 decision
criteria: Value realised tracked monthly against the business case

gates.name: Wave 2 live
criteria: Business cases for UC-03 and UC-07 reviewed

items.title: Production build and TMS integration
items.deliverable: Pipeline posting to the TMS import API, with retries and an audit log

items.title: Review queue in the doc desk's tooling
items.deliverable: Queue that shows flagged fields, reasons and the source document side by side

items.title: Shadow mode on real documents
items.deliverable: Pipeline runs next to the clerks; differences labelled; first real evaluation set

items.title: Go-live: bills of lading and packing lists
items.deliverable: Two document types straight-through within the error budget

items.title: Go-live: invoices, CMRs, delivery orders
items.deliverable: All five document types live

items.title: Business KPI dashboard
items.deliverable: Straight-through rate, escapes from the audit sample, review time, value realised

items.title: UC-09 carrier invoice audit: pilot
items.deliverable: Reuses the document pipeline; measured on 3 months of carrier invoices

items.title: UC-02 customer e-mail triage: pilot
items.deliverable: Drafts for status questions, agent sends; measured on handling time and quality

items.title: UC-09 and UC-02 to production
items.deliverable: Both live, monitored on the same platform

items.title: UC-03 customs classification: discovery and pilot
items.deliverable: Pilot on 300 past classifications, declarant in the loop

items.title: UC-07 route optimisation: data clean-up and vendor selection
items.deliverable: Clean location data; buy decision between 3 planning tools

items.title: AI orchestration layer v1
items.deliverable: Model gateway, prompt registry, logging, evaluation harness, cost tracking

items.title: TMS document API agreed with the vendor
items.deliverable: Documented endpoint for document records; file-drop fallback

items.title: Data owners for customer, location and document data
items.deliverable: Named owners, change process, monthly quality report

items.title: Labelled evaluation sets per use case
items.deliverable: Real documents, labelled during review, refreshed quarterly

items.title: AI policy and acceptable use
items.deliverable: One-page policy, approved tools list, rules for customer data

items.title: AI inventory and EU AI Act classification
items.deliverable: Register of AI systems with risk tier, owner and review date; quarterly refresh

items.title: AI in the ISO/IEC 27001 ISMS
items.deliverable: AI suppliers assessed, risk register and Statement of Applicability updated

items.title: DPIA for customer e-mail triage
items.deliverable: DPIA signed before the UC-02 pilot touches real e-mails

items.title: AI literacy programme (three tiers)
items.deliverable: All staff 90 minutes; users half a day; builders two days

items.title: Works council information and consultation
items.deliverable: Plan presented before go-live; agreement on no redundancies and attrition

items.title: Sanctioned AI assistant for all office staff
items.deliverable: One approved assistant inside Microsoft 365; covers drafting and knowledge needs (UC-04, UC-10) without custom builds

items.title: AI champions network
items.deliverable: Eight champions, two hours a week, monthly show-and-tell

items.title: Readiness re-assessment and portfolio refresh
items.deliverable: Updated scorecard, ranked portfolio, year-2 plan
